# SoundFont test fixture

`minimal.sf2` is generated by `generate-soundfont.py`. It contains one original
mathematical sine sample (400 samples plus interpolation guards), a looping
preset named Test sine, and a minimal uncompressed SF2 hydra. No third-party
sample bank or recording is included. The generator and fixture use the same
MIT license as NativeKit. Run `python3 generate-soundfont.py` to reproduce it.

This fixture tests parsing, metadata, token identity, lifetime, block partition
invariance, polyphony and callback allocation behavior. It does not qualify
arbitrary bank fidelity or the cost of complex multi-layer/modulated presets.
